discussion_comments.comment_body: ✅ Fixed at the database layer. Updated `getProviderConnections` in `src/lib/db/providers.ts` to natively support filtering by `authType`. This avoids fetching and decrypting all connections in memory.

Fixed in commit ffb5aff8. The `ApiKeysDbLike` interface intentionally exposes only `prepare` + `exec` (kept minimal across better-sqlite3 / node:sqlite / sql.js backends) so `db.transaction()` is not available. Wrapped the SELECT-previousScopes + UPDATE in `BEGIN IMMEDIATE` / `COMMIT` via `db.exec`, with `ROLLBACK` on error. Same atomicity guarantee, works on every backend.

We intentionally avoid raw LIKE here because provider IDs are data and may contain LIKE wildcards (% / _). This is a destructive delete path, so exact prefix matching is preferred over the small potential index benefit. The number of syncedAvailableModels rows is bounded by provider connections, so the scan cost is acceptable.
